$ go test  # chain-past
    export/packed: unpack and repack make a script that evaluate prints a1 from.
        repack: Repacks the unpacked export as a script, as its repack/ tree says.
        out/repack/outcome differs (-golden +got):
        - accepted
        + blocked unpack
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
        via/repack/evaluate/out/values.txt is recorded, and repack is blocked: the lift unpack, on repack's path, failed on the case, so it has no product.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which removes it, and read the diff before committing.

        + rejected

$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-past
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    export/packed: unpack and repack make a script that evaluate prints a1 from.
        evaluate: Does what the case's evaluate/ tree says, from the stage it consumes.
        out/evaluate/values.txt is recorded, and the cell is blocked: the lift unpack, on evaluate's path, failed on the case.
        If the cell should run, fix the lift or the case. If not, delete the section by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves it in place.
    export/packed: unpack and repack make a script that evaluate prints a1 from.
        list: Lists the files of the script's input view, with their bytes.
        out/list/files.txt is recorded, and the cell is blocked: the lift unpack, on list's path, failed on the case.
        If the cell should run, fix the lift or the case. If not, delete the section by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves it in place.
    export/packed: parse is blocked: the lift unpack failed on the case, and testdata/export/packed.txtar, out/unpack/error.txt, records its error.
